waits.boundary_policy: Full start-second buckets; intervals can finish beyond a bucket/window. Long idle parks must not be attributed to request latency.
waits.state_policy: All switch-out intervals pooled. The raw runnable flag means tracepoint prev_state == 0 and is not a complete runnable/sleep classification on this kernel, which also encodes preemption as R+.
